title: Identifying musicians in a band photograph
summary: Looking at a photograph, they identify Bill Matthews, Cottrell, Steve Lewis, Henry and Charlie Bocage, Henry Martin and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, you see that's Bill there. You see that's when Bill was playing with us, you see? Yeah. But after Bill left, then old Mike Cottrell came in, see? Mm-hmm.
Bill had a brother play drum, too. He used to play with us. Oh, there's none. Oh, Bebe.

It's a superior band, yeah. Yeah, I'm playing trombone there. Who's that guy? Willie Edwards, his name was. That's Steve there. That's Steve there. That's Warnock. That's Warnock, if you're wrong. Oh, uh-huh.
Look at this. That's you there. Yeah. That's the one in California, my brother. Henry? That's the bass player, yes. He's bass there.
Yeah. That's Lloyd Warnock, too. That's Newman's daddy, see? Dwight Newman. That's Martin, and that's Charlie, see? Mm-hmm.
That's a... He looks awful young, this, this Henry Martin. Looks awful young there, doesn't he?
Yeah, Martin. Looks very young. We was playing, uh... That is the old man, Henry Martin. He never had no daddy that played drums. No.
Did he have a son, Henry Martin, that played drums?
Yeah, he had a... He had a son, but he didn't play anything.
